message.text: GNURUST.SCREENIO.ATTR.1 non-claim: COLOUR attributes (FOREGROUND-COLOR / BACKGROUND-COLOR) -- those trigger a whole-screen colour repaint (the terminfo bce path with an extra clear/\e[J/\e[K), a separate mechanism NOT sealed here
GNURUST.SCREENIO.ATTR.1 non-claim: COMBINED attributes (e.g. HIGHLIGHT UNDERLINE together)
GNURUST.SCREENIO.ATTR.1 non-claim: attributes on multi-field or numeric-edited displays
GNURUST.SCREENIO.ATTR.1 non-claim: any terminal other than TERM=xterm or ncurses other than the admitted 6.6 (terminfo-dependent)

GNURUST.SCREENIO.ATTR.1 non-claim: lie prevented: screen display attributes need ncurses linked -- NO (for the monochrome attributes): each is a deterministic SGR on/off wrap reproduced exactly, no ncurses linked. The colour-repaint path is honestly carved out as unsealed
